d:
Inside the organization's entertainment facility, members could choose a remarkably cost-effective option.
Several small chambers were arranged in a row, each fitted with one-way glass. Those outside could not see in, but those inside had no way of seeing out. The tickle slaves were confined in these narrow spaces, their bodies restrained, with only their feet protruding through openings in the wall—bare soles exposed to the open air.
For a very small fee, members could freely toy with the pair of highly ticklish, tender feet before them. Whether using fingers to tickle, feathers to brush, or brushes to scrub back and forth—the owner of those feet would writhe, laugh, and beg for mercy inside the chamber, unable to see who was tormenting her. Meanwhile, the member could watch every reaction through the one-way glass, enjoying this unequal, utterly dominant form of entertainment.
Her hands might have been simply cuffed, and the rest of her body not particularly restrained. But her feet—those were locked firmly on the other side of the wall, unable to move an inch.
No matter how wildly she twisted her body, no matter how desperately she screamed, laughed, and cried, those exposed feet could not be pulled back. She could feel the fingertips tracing across her soles, the gentle sweep of feathers, the friction of a brush—yet she couldn't even curl her toes to escape. The wall was an unbreachable line, sealing her struggles completely on this side.
The screams grew louder, the laughter more unhinged, but her feet remained there—bare, exposed, with nowhere to hide. And on the other side of the wall, the hands continued.
The feet twisted, wriggled, curled—every reaction only delighted the tickler further.
Every twitch of the toes, every tensing of the arch, every futile scrape of the heel invited more precise, more devious attacks. Those fingers seemed to read every signal the soles transmitted, always pausing, pressing, and scratching at the most sensitive spots.
None of their struggles could free them from the tickling beneath their feet. Instead, every movement became part of the game—a performance for an audience. The harder they tried to escape, the more impossible it became. The more they laughed, the louder the laughter grew around them. It was a loop with no way out.
The facility also offered a more comprehensive restraint service for the ticklers.
By simply clamping the big toe and the little toe, the foot's ability to escape was drastically reduced. The toes could no longer curl away, the arch could no longer tense in resistance, and even the most basic twisting became sluggish and feeble.
The tickle slave's feet grew even more helpless—no longer capable of any effective resistance against the tickling, simply lying there bare and still, waiting for the next assault. For the tickler, this restraint made every stroke more precise, more leisurely, and the pleasure multiplied accordingly.
Once the toes were secured, the more meticulous torment began.
The spaces between the toes, the tips, the pads—every inch was tickled in turn, leaving no spot untouched. Fingers or tools slid back and forth along the crevices, delving into those most hidden gaps. The tips of the toes were gently pressed and circled, triggering involuntary twitches. And the plump toe pads endured repeated teasing, each layer of ticklish sensation building upon the last.
There was no pause, no corner to hide in. The feet seemed to have been disassembled into countless independent zones, each one under precise assault. And all she could do was watch—or rather, laugh, cry, and twist—as she endured it all.
The laughter came through a speaker.
"Hahaha… it tickles hahaha!! Stop it hahaha!! Mercy, hahaha—!"
The voice was sharp and broken, a jumble of laughter and sobs, echoing through the space. Through the one-way glass, the former valiant female forensic investigator of the International Special Crime Countermeasures Unit was now strapped inside a narrow chamber, her hands cuffed, her feet protruding through an opening in the wall, her bare soles writhing under the tickler's fingertips.
She could not reach her own feet to scratch them, nor could she pull them back. All she could do was claw wildly at her own hair, fingers digging into her scalp and yanking in desperation, as if that might somehow distract from the unbearable tickling rising from her soles. Her face was streaked with tears and sweat, her hair was a tangled mess, and her mouth was stretched into an uncontrollable grin, producing endless laughter.
The woman who once calmly analyzed evidence and faced crime scenes with composure—she was now no different from any other woman who was ticklish. All that training, all that pride, everything that once set her apart—none of it mattered here.
Mechanical brushes worked between her toes, using shifting frequencies to precisely target the most ticklish spots—wherever they happened to be at that moment. Every toe crevice was stuffed with one of these tormenting devices. None were missed. None rested.
She tried to scream. She tried to beg. But the moment the sounds left her throat, they were swallowed by laughter. "Stop—hahaha!! Please—hahaha!! I'm begging you—hahaha!!"
In the end, all her words lost meaning. Her screams became laughter. Her pleas became laughter. Even she could no longer tell whether she was crying or laughing. The only thing that came out was that single, uncontrollable, ceaseless laughter—welling up endlessly from the depths of her throat.
The woman, drenched in sweat, could now only produce silent laughter.
Her mouth was wide open, a hoarse rasp escaping from deep in her throat, but no laughter could form. Tears and sweat mingled, streaming down her cheeks and dripping onto her already-soaked collar. Her body still convulsed, her toes still curled—but the sound, the thing that had once echoed sharply through the room, was gone.
This daily existence of being tickled was pushing her to the brink of utter collapse.
She no longer knew how long she had been imprisoned here. Days? Weeks? Time had lost all meaning. Each time her feet were pushed through the opening in the wall, each time the mechanical brushes worked between her toes, something was stripped away from her—dignity, sanity, or something even more essential. All she knew was that when the laughter could no longer come out, she had even lost the ability to beg for mercy.
This round of tickling had been set for two hours, and it was almost over.
The whir of the mechanical brushes began to fade. The little nubs that had tormented her toe crevices for two full hours finally slowed their pace. Her body still convulsed, still twitched reflexively, but the throat-tearing laughter would no longer come—only hoarse gasps and an occasional sob remained.
Yet for this woman, now reduced to a tickle slave, this was merely the first session of the day.
First. The word echoed through her blank mind. She had no idea whether there would be a second, a third, or even more today. All she knew was that when those damned brushes finally stopped, she didn't even have the strength to feel relief—because she understood that this was not an end. It was only a brief pause.
n: [Artist CG] [whywhatwhy] One time, after becoming a tickle slave
